competing_explanation: The 30-day window may be outdated, apply only to specific categories, or be a partial-refund/exchange window rather than a full-refund window.
hypothesis_statement: The current return policy for standard items provides a 30-day full-refund return window.
refutation_criterion: The current authoritative policy states a different number of days, limits full refunds to a shorter period, or excludes standard items from the 30-day full-refund window.
